per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP03237 is source_verified from primary sequence text and Table 2/prose. APD6 AP03238 is preserved as source_conflict because the 45 μM APD6 summary follows abstract prose while Table 3 and DBAASP rows preserve 82/164 μM values, and the synthetic TRP2 assay used a norleucine substitution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity/toxicity evidence was rebuilt from XML/PDF Table 2, Table 3, toxicity prose, and Figure 6; source-reported NA rows are retained as not-active evidence and no absent numeric value is fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: The OA package and supplementary indexes were opened; no separate supplementary tables/files exist locally, so the prior supplement blocker is closed as no local supplement to recover.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 records 45 μM for E. coli/P. aeruginosa; primary Table 3 and merged DBAASP rows preserve 82/164 μM values for the synthetic TRP2-TINF norleucine analog.
Primary sequence is APAAGFFGMR, while synthetic TRP2-TINF activity/degradation assays changed methionine to norleucine; final records do not silently normalize this modification.
Merged APD6 text labels AP03238 as TRP1-TINF while describing tachykinin-related peptide II; final audit preserves the conflict and uses source TRP2-TINF identity.
Packet supplementary index and extraction report show no separate supplementary files/tables. Source review used XML, PDF, OA package members, and database rows instead.
The paper supplies CD/stability context but not direct membrane permeabilization or molecular target experiments for TRP1/TRP2.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 at the obtainable-only standard. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions because source-supported activity/toxicity rows are retained, APD6 AP03238 conflicts are explicit, no local supplement remains unrecovered, and worker-6 does not overclaim mechanism evidence.
